metaDescription: Shop custom rectangular pennants for events, sports, and branding. Bulk orders available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Rectangular pennants offer a clean, classic shape that stands out from traditional swallowtail designs. They provide a larger printable area for logos, slogans, and artwork, making them ideal for corporate events, trade shows, or team spirit items. Whether screen printed or embroidered, the straight edges create a polished look that fits well in offices, dorm rooms, or retail displays. Choose from felt or polyester materials in custom colors to match your brand.
heroAltText: Custom rectangular pennants with printed logo and fringe trim on felt material
